title: Does humidity matter? Prenatal heat and child health in South Asia.
abstract: Heat extremes pose substantial health risks during pregnancy and early childhood. High humidity exacerbates heat strain, but its long-term effects on health remain poorly understood. We compare the effect of prenatal exposure to extreme humid heat versus heat alone on child growth in South Asia, where high rates of child stunting meet rapidly accelerating hot-humid extremes. After adjusting for sociodemographic, seasonal, and spatial confounders, we use within-community variation in children’s ages to isolate the impact of prenatal exposures. We find that hot-humid exposures are much more detrimental to health than hot temperatures alone, with the potential to increase stunting in South Asia by over 3 million children by 2050. These findings underscore the importance of accounting for humidity when estimating and localizing climate change impacts.
abstract_zh: 极端高温在孕期和幼儿期会带来重大健康风险。高湿度会加剧热应激，但其对健康的长期影响仍鲜为人知。我们比较了南亚地区孕期暴露于极端湿热与仅暴露于高温对儿童生长发育的影响，该地区儿童发育迟缓率较高，同时湿热极端天气正在迅速加剧。在对社会人口、季节和空间混杂因素进行调整后，我们利用同一社区内儿童年龄的差异，分离出产前暴露的影响。我们发现，湿热暴露对健康的危害远大于单纯的高温，到2050年，其可能使南亚发育迟缓的儿童增加300多万。这些发现强调了在估算和本地化气候变化影响时考虑湿度因素的重要性。

title: Identifying farmers' response to changes in marginal and average subsidies using deep learning
abstract: Much of the developed world has adopted substantial, complex agricultural subsidy schemes in an attempt to produce desired rural livelihood and environmental outcomes. Understanding how farmers adjust their production activity in response to farm subsidies is crucial for setting optimal agricultural policy. Whereas standard economic theory suggests that farmers largely adjust production levels in response to prices and marginal subsidy rates, recent work in consumer behavior suggests that average (dis‐)incentives may play a relevant role. We use a unique panel covering all farms applying for subsidies in Norway and a flexible deep‐learning method to exploit kinks in the subsidy scheme to answer whether farmers respond more to average or marginal subsidies. In contrast to the standard economic theory of production, we find suggestive empirical evidence that farmers respond more to changes in average payments than to changes in marginal payments. We anticipate that our findings on the relevance of average payment levels for farmers' decision making may inspire further theoretical and empirical inquiries into agricultural policy effects. The study also highlights how novel deep‐learning tools can be applied for detailed policy analysis and what advantages and challenges come with it. We believe that this approach has substantial potential for analysts and policymakers to evaluate and predict the impacts of policy options.
abstract_zh: 发达国家的大多数地区都采用了复杂的大规模农业补贴制度，以期实现理想的农村生计和环境目标。了解农民如何根据农业补贴调整生产活动，对于制定最优农业政策至关重要。标准经济理论认为，农民主要根据价格和边际补贴率调整生产水平，而消费者行为领域的最新研究则表明，平均（负）激励可能发挥着相关作用。我们利用一个涵盖挪威所有申请补贴农场的独特面板数据，并采用灵活的深度学习方法，利用补贴制度中的拐点，以回答农民对平均补贴与边际补贴的反应哪个更强。与生产的标准经济理论相反，我们发现了一些暗示性的经验证据，表明农民对平均支付水平变化的反应比对边际支付变化的反应更强。我们预计，我们关于平均支付水平对农民决策重要性的发现，可能会激发对农业政策效果进一步的理论和实证探究。本研究还揭示了新型深度学习工具如何应用于细致的政策分析，以及其中所伴随的优势与挑战。我们认为，该方法在分析人员和政策制定者评估和预测各种政策选项的影响方面具有巨大潜力。

title: Is closing the agricultural yield gap a "risky" endeavor?
abstract: CONTEXT: Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) has the climatic and biophysical potential to produce the crops it needs to meet rapidly growing food demand; however, agricultural productivity remains low. While potential maize yields in Zambia are 9 tonnes per hectare (t/ha), the average farmer produces only 1-2.OBJECTIVE: We evaluate the contribution of responses to weather risk to that gap by decomposing the yield gap in maize in Zambia. While we know that improved seed and fertilizer can expand yield and profit, they may also increase the variance of yield under different weather outcomes, reducing their adoption.METHODS: We use a novel approach combining crop modeling and statistical analysis of survey data to obtain the yield gap components in Zambia driven by input cost and input risk . We use a crop model to simulate district-level marginal effects of fertilizer and seed maturity choice on the mean and variance of expected yield and profit under all-weather outcomes for each district for the past 30 years. We compare input levels that maximize expected yield to those that maximize expected profit and maximize the expected mean-variance trade-off assuming risk-aversion. To determine how much farmers’ input choices are made to reduce risk, we then quantify differences in the expected riskiness of inputs by district. RESULTS AND CONCLUSIONS: We find approximately one-quarter of the yield gap can be explained by risk-reducing behavior, albeit with a substantial geographic variation. Given this finding, under present conditions, we expect that the average maximum yield that farmers can obtain without increasing risk is 6.75 t/ha compared to a potential profit-maximizing level of 8.84 t/ha.SIGNIFICANCE: The risk-related yield gap is only expected to increase with weather extremes driven by climate change. Promoting “one-size-fits all” solutions to closing the yield gap could underestimate the effect of risk mitigation on agricultural production while increasing farmers’ risk exposure.
abstract_zh: 背景：撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）在气候和生物物理条件上具备生产所需作物的潜力，以满足快速增长的粮食需求；然而，该地区的农业生产力仍然较低。赞比亚玉米的潜在产量为每公顷9吨（t/ha），而普通农民的产量仅为1至2吨。目标：我们通过分解赞比亚玉米的产量差距，评估对天气风险的应对措施在多大程度上造成了这一差距。虽然我们知道改良种子和化肥可以提高产量和利润，但它们也可能增加不同天气条件下产量的方差，从而降低其采用率。方法：我们结合作物模型与调查数据的统计分析，采用一种新方法，以获得赞比亚由投入成本和投入风险所驱动的产量差距组成部分。我们运用作物模型，模拟了过去30年间各区在所有天气情景下，化肥和种子成熟度选择对预期产量和利润的均值与方差的边际效应。我们比较了使预期产量最大化的投入水平与使预期利润最大化的投入水平，并在假设风险厌恶的情况下，比较了使均值-方差权衡最大化的投入水平。为了确定农民的投入选择在多大程度上是为了降低风险，我们进一步量化了各区投入预期风险性的差异。结果与结论：我们发现，大约四分之一的产量差距可由降低风险的行为来解释，但存在显著的地理差异。鉴于这一发现，在当前条件下，我们预计农民在不增加风险的情况下可获得的平均最大产量为每公顷6.75吨，而利润最大化的潜在产量水平为每公顷8.84吨。意义：在气候变化导致极端天气加剧的背景下，与风险相关的产量差距预计只会进一步扩大。推行“一刀切”的解决方案来缩小产量差距，可能会低估风险缓解对农业生产的作用，同时还会增加农民的风险暴露。

title: Agri-Environmental Programs in the United States and Canada.
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Canada and the United States have a rich history of policy interventions aimed at improving environmental outcomes from agricultural production. We review the agri-environmental programs in these two countries as well as the related economic literature. Despite the impacts of agriculture on land, water, and climate quality, the literature on agri-environmental programs has largely focused on a few major programs or the adoption of specific management practices. Far less research evaluates programs on active farmland, environmental regulation of agriculture, and the interactions of these policies and programs. Further research is also needed on how the heterogeneity of environmental characteristics and processes affects the outcomes of management practices and how these outcomes might be affected by climate change. Given the continued substantial impacts of agriculture on environmental outcomes, the increased interest of agricultural processors and consumers in these outcomes, and the potential for new models and data to inform research, we conclude that this is an ideal time to examine and apply lessons learned from past program successes and failures as we seek to improve the performance of the next generation of agri-environmental policy interventions.
abstract_zh: 加拿大和美国在旨在改善农业生产环境结果的政策干预方面有着悠久的历史。我们回顾了这两个国家的农业环境计划以及相关的经济学文献。尽管农业对土地、水质和气候质量均有影响，但关于农业环境计划的文献主要集中在少数几个主要计划或特定管理做法的采用上。针对仍在耕种农田上实施的计划、农业环境监管，以及这些政策和计划之间的相互作用，相关研究要少得多。关于环境特征与过程的异质性如何影响管理做法的结果，以及这些结果可能如何受到气候变化影响，也需要进一步研究。鉴于农业对环境结果的持续重大影响，农产品加工商和消费者对这些结果的兴趣日益增加，以及新模型和新数据为研究提供信息的潜力，我们认为，现在正是总结和应用过去计划成败经验的理想时机，以期提升下一代农业环境政策干预的绩效。

title: Evidence for the impacts of agroforestry on ecosystem services and human well-being in high-income countries: a systematic map.
abstract:
Agroforestry bridges the gap that often separates agriculture and forestry by building integrated systems to address both environmental and socio-economic objectives. Existing empirical research has suggested that agroforestry—the integration of trees with crops and/or livestock—can prevent environmental degradation, improve agricultural productivity, increase carbon sequestration, and support healthy soil and healthy ecosystems while providing stable incomes and other benefits to human welfare. However, the extent of the literature supporting or refuting these claims has not been well documented. This study addresses this research gap by collating and describing the evidence for the impacts of agroforestry on ecosystem services and human well-being in high-income countries and presents the characteristics and gaps in the literature.
We searched 5 primary databases and 24 organizational websites using a pre-defined search string designed to capture articles relating agroforestry practices and policy interventions to outcomes in high-income countries. Searches included peer-reviewed and grey literature published in the English language between January 1990 and June 2020. We screened the identified articles for inclusion or exclusion in two stages: title/abstract and full text. We extracted data from articles included at the full-text stage to form the map and associated database. For inclusion, the study in question must have assessed the impacts of the deliberate promotion and/or actual integration of woody perennials (trees, shrubs, etc.) with agricultural crops and/or animals.
Our search returned 31,852 articles of which we included 585 primary articles, 6 ongoing primary articles, and 41 systematically conducted literature reviews. The articles spanned three decades and 31 countries. The most studied practices are on linear boundary plantings (hedgerows, shelterbelts, windbreaks, and riparian buffers) and silvopasture systems. The most studied outcome is regulation and maintenance of physical, chemical, and biological conditions as an ecosystem service, followed by agricultural yield and mediation of waste/toxics/other nuisances (nutrient runoff and carbon storage).
Results highlight key evidence gaps and areas where research has concentrated. Knowledge on the impacts of specific policy interventions to promote agroforestry remains scarce. The impacts of actual agroforestry practices are more well-studied, but the kinds of practices studied are limited, with most research focusing on two-component systems consisting of a simple tree configuration with one crop or livestock species, such as shelterbelts, windbreaks, and hedgerows, riparian buffers, and scattered trees on farms with crops and/or livestock. Regulating ecosystem services outcomes are by far the most studied, followed by agricultural productivity (an aspect of provisioning ecosystem services), while evidence on human well-being remains limited. We also found geographic biases, with little to no evidence for many countries. These biases suggest the strong need for further research to build the evidence base on agroforestry across high-income countries. The results can inform future research and policy decisions by making the evidence easily accessible and highlighting knowledge gaps as well as areas with enough evidence to conduct further systematic review.
abstract_zh:
农林复合经营（agroforestry）弥合了农业与林业之间常见的鸿沟，通过构建综合系统来同时实现环境和社会经济目标。已有实证研究表明，农林复合经营，即将树木与农作物和/或牲畜相结合，能够防止环境退化、提高农业生产力、增加碳汇、支持健康的土壤和生态系统，同时提供稳定的收入以及其他有利于人类福祉的益处。然而，支持或反驳这些论断的文献的范围尚未得到充分记录。本研究通过整理并描述高收入国家中农林复合经营对生态系统服务和人类福祉影响的证据，填补了这一研究空白，并呈现了现有文献的特征和不足。
我们使用预先设定的检索式，在5个主要数据库和24个机构网站中进行检索，检索式旨在涵盖将农林复合经营实践和政策干预与高收入国家的结果相关联的文章。检索范围包括1990年1月至2020年6月以英文发表的同行评议文献和灰色文献。我们分两个阶段筛选所识别的文章是否纳入或排除：先按标题和摘要，再按全文。我们从进入全文阶段的纳入文章中提取数据，以形成证据图谱及相关数据库。纳入标准要求，所考察的研究必须评估了有意推广和/或实际整合木本多年生植物（乔木、灌木等）与农作物和/或牲畜的影响。
我们的检索共返回31,852篇文章，其中纳入585篇主要文章、6篇在研的主要文章，以及41篇系统开展的文献综述。这些文章跨越三十年，涉及31个国家。研究最多的实践是线性边界种植（树篱、防护林、防风林和河岸缓冲带）以及林牧复合系统。研究最多的结果是作为生态系统服务的物理、化学和生物条件的调节与维持，其次是农业产量以及对废物、有毒物质或其他滋扰（养分径流和碳储存）的缓解。
结果突显了关键的证据空白，以及研究集中的领域。关于推动农林复合经营的具体政策干预的影响，相关知识仍然匮乏。农林复合经营实践本身的影响研究较为充分，但所研究的实践类型有限，大多数研究集中于双组分系统，即由简单的树木配置与一种作物或牲畜品种组成，例如防护林、防风林和树篱、河岸缓冲带，以及农场中与作物和/或牲畜并存的散生树木。调节性生态系统服务结果是迄今为止研究最多的，其次是农业生产力（生态系统服务中供给服务的一个方面），而关于人类福祉的证据仍然有限。我们还发现了地理上的偏倚，许多国家几乎没有相关证据。这些偏倚表明，高收入国家需要进一步开展研究，以建立农林复合经营的证据基础。这些结果可以为未来的研究和政策决策提供参考，通过使证据易于获取，并突出知识空白以及证据充足、足以开展进一步系统综述的领域。

Agricultural decision-making and climate uncertainty in developing countries
abstract: In situations of uncertainty, people often make decisions with heuristic shortcuts or decision rules, rather than using computational or logical methods such as optimizing their behavior based on specific goals. The high level of uncertainty and complexity involved in adapting to climate change suggests that heuristics would be commonly used in this context rather than more structured decision methods. Through a systematic review of 137 articles, from 2007–2017 we explore the behavioral and cognitive assumptions used to examine agricultural decision-making related to climate change among farmers in developing countries. We find a strong orientation toward modeling behavior and decision making as a rational utility-maximizing process, despite decades of research demonstrating the prevalence of simpler heuristic choice when facing uncertainty and real-world constraints. Behavioral and cognitive approaches can increase our ability to predict or explain decisions being made in this realm, particularly in terms of how we understand decision making around information processing and risk assessment. In the following review, we highlight articles that have contributed to developing a more realistic decision-making framework for studying this problem on the ground. While there is a burgeoning literature using psychological insights to examine decision making under climate uncertainty, few studies consider the prevalence of simple heuristics, the presence of cognitive biases, and the salience of climate relative to other risk factors.
abstract_zh: 在不确定的情况下，人们往往借助启发式捷径或决策规则进行决策，而不是通过计算或逻辑方法，例如基于特定目标优化其行为。适应气候变化所涉及的高度不确定性和复杂性表明，在这一背景下，启发式方法比更为结构化的决策方法更为常见。通过对2007至2017年间137篇文章的系统综述，我们探讨了在考察发展中国家农民应对气候变化的农业决策时所使用的行为和认知假设。我们发现，尽管数十年的研究已证明，面对不确定性和现实约束时简单启发式选择普遍存在，但相关研究仍强烈倾向于将行为和决策建模为理性效用最大化过程。行为和认知方法可以提高我们预测或解释这一领域决策的能力，尤其是在理解信息处理和风险评估方面的决策时。在以下综述中，我们重点介绍了那些有助于构建更符合实际的决策框架、以研究这一现实问题的文章。虽然已有大量文献运用心理学见解来考察气候不确定性下的决策，但很少有研究考虑简单启发式的普遍性、认知偏差的存在，以及气候风险相对于其他风险因素的显著性。

title: Assessing the downstream socioeconomic impacts of agroforestry in Kenya.
Machine Learning in Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: This review presents machine learning (ML) approaches from an applied economist’s perspective. We first introduce the key ML methods drawing connections to econometric practice. We then identify current limitations of the econometric and simulation model toolbox in applied economics and explore potential solutions afforded by ML. We dive into cases such as inflexible functional forms, unstructured data sources and large numbers of explanatory variables in both prediction and causal analysis, and highlight the challenges of complex simulation models. Finally, we argue that economists have a vital role in addressing the shortcomings of ML when used for quantitative economic analysis.
abstract_zh: 本综述从应用经济学家的视角介绍机器学习（ML）方法。我们首先介绍主要的机器学习方法，并将其与计量经济学实践建立联系。随后，我们指出应用经济学中计量经济学和模拟模型工具箱目前存在的局限性，并探讨机器学习可能提供的解决方案。我们深入探讨了若干案例，包括不灵活的函数形式、非结构化数据源，以及在预测和因果分析中存在大量解释变量的情形，并强调了复杂模拟模型所面临的挑战。最后，我们认为，经济学家在应对机器学习用于定量经济分析时的不足方面，具有至关重要的作用。

title: Re-envisioning sanitation as a human-derived resource system.
abstract: Sanitation remains a global challenge, both in terms of access to toilet facilities and resource intensity (e.g., energy consumption) of waste treatment. Overcoming barriers to universal sanitation coverage and sustainable resource management requires approaches that manage bodily excreta within coupled human and natural systems. In recent years, numerous analytical methods have been developed to understand cross-disciplinary constraints, opportunities, and trade-offs around sanitation and resource recovery. However, without a shared language or conceptual framework, efforts from individual disciplines or geographic contexts may remain isolated, preventing the accumulation of generalized knowledge. Here, we develop a version of the social-ecological systems framework modified for the specific characteristics of bodily excreta. This framework offers a shared vision for sanitation as a human-derived resource system, where people are part of the resource cycle. Through sanitation technologies and management strategies, resources including water, organics, and nutrients accumulate, transform, and impact human experiences and natural environments. Within the framework, we establish a multitiered lexicon of variables, characterized by breadth and depth, to support harmonized understanding and development of models and analytical approaches. This framework's refinement and use will guide interdisciplinary study around sanitation to identify guiding principles for sanitation that advance sustainable development at the nature-society interface.
abstract_zh: 卫生设施问题仍是全球性挑战，无论是在厕所设施的普及方面，还是在废物处理的资源密集度（如能源消耗）方面。要克服普遍实现卫生设施覆盖和可持续资源管理的障碍，需要采取在人类与自然相互耦合的系统中管理人体排泄物的方法。近年来，已开发出众多分析方法，用以理解卫生设施和资源回收中跨学科的约束、机遇和权衡。然而，若缺乏共同的语言或概念框架，各学科或各地理背景下的努力可能仍然相互孤立，从而阻碍广义知识的积累。在此，我们针对人体排泄物的特定属性，对社会-生态系统框架进行了改进，形成一个版本。该框架为卫生设施提供了一个共同愿景，即将其视为人类派生的资源系统，人类本身即是资源循环的一部分。通过卫生设施技术和管理策略，水、有机物和养分等资源得以积累、转化，并影响人类体验和自然环境。在该框架内，我们建立了一套多层次的变量词汇表，兼顾广度与深度，以支持对相关模型和分析方法形成统一的理解并加以发展。该框架的完善与应用将指导围绕卫生设施开展跨学科研究，以确定推动可持续发展的卫生设施指导原则，并使其立足于自然与社会的交界面。

Agricultural Market Liberalization and Household Food Security in Rural China.
abstract: In the 1990s, prior to its accession to the World Trade Organization, China dramatically reduced market distortions in agriculture. We use a panel of 6,770 rural households from 1989 to 2000 to ask whether agricultural market liberalization affected rural household food security as measured by the share of calories from non‐staples. Given that not all households may be able to take advantage of new market opportunities, we focus on the distributional effect of market liberalization. Unlike most previous research on the effects of liberalization, we consider the effects of liberalization on both farm and off‐farm income. We find that liberalization primarily improves household food security by increasing off‐farm income, and the effects vary greatly by initial food security status and producer types. While many households benefit from liberalization, some food‐insecure households producing import‐competing products have lower food security as a result of agricultural market liberalization.
abstract_zh: 20世纪90年代，中国在加入世界贸易组织之前，大幅减少了农业领域的市场扭曲。我们利用1989至2000年间6,770户农村家庭的面板数据，考察农业市场自由化是否影响了农村家庭的粮食安全，粮食安全以非主食热量占比来衡量。鉴于并非所有家庭都能利用新的市场机会，我们重点考察市场自由化的分配效应。与以往关于自由化效应的大多数研究不同，我们同时考虑了自由化对农业收入和非农收入的影响。研究发现，自由化主要通过增加非农收入来改善家庭粮食安全，且其效应因初始粮食安全状况和生产者类型而差异很大。虽然许多家庭从自由化中获益，但一些生产与进口竞争产品相关的粮食不安全家庭，由于农业市场自由化，其粮食安全水平反而有所下降。

title: An approach to improving early warning systems: Using spatially and temporally rich data to predict food insecurity crises in Malawi.
Are Non-Market Values Important to Smallholders' Afforestation Decisions? A Psychometric Segmentation and its Implications for Afforestation Programs.
Conservation Agriculture and Climate Resilience.
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Agricultural productivity growth is vital for economic and food security outcomes which are threatened by climate change. In response, governments and development agencies are encouraging the adoption of 'climate-smart' agricultural technologies, such as conservation agriculture (CA). However, there is little rigorous evidence that demonstrates the effect of CA on production or climate resilience, and what evidence exists is hampered by selection bias. Using panel data from Zimbabwe, we test how CA performs during extreme rainfall events - both shortfalls and surpluses. We control for the endogenous adoption decision and find that use of CA in years of average rainfall results in no yield gains, and in some cases yield loses. However, CA is effective in mitigating the negative impacts of deviations in rainfall. We conclude that the lower yields during normal rainfall seasons may be a proximate factor in low uptake of CA. Policy should focus promotion of CA on these climate resilience benefits.
abstract_zh: 农业生产率增长对于经济和粮食安全至关重要，而气候变化正在威胁这一增长。作为应对，各国政府和发展机构正在鼓励采用“气候智能型”农业技术，例如保护性农业（CA）。然而，几乎没有严谨的证据表明保护性农业对产量或气候韧性有何影响，而现有证据又受到选择性偏误的困扰。利用津巴布韦的面板数据，我们检验了保护性农业在极端降雨事件（包括降雨不足和降雨过多）中的表现。我们控制了内生的采用决策，发现在平均降雨年份采用保护性农业并不会带来产量增长，在某些情况下甚至会造成减产。然而，保护性农业能够有效缓解降雨偏离正常水平所带来的负面影响。我们的结论是，在正常降雨季节产量较低，可能是保护性农业采用率低的直接原因。政策应当将保护性农业的推广重点放在其气候韧性效益上。

title: Integrated approaches to understanding and reducing drought impact on food security across scales.
abstract: Understanding the cross-scale linkages between drought and food security is vital to developing tools to reduce drought impacts and support decision making. This study reviews how drought hazards transfer to food insecurity through changes in physical processes and socio-environmental systems across a wide range of spatial and temporal scales. We propose a multi-scale, integrated framework leveraging modeling advances (e.g. drought and crop monitoring, water-food-energy nexus, decision making) and increased data availability (e.g. satellite remote sensing, food trade) through the lens of the coupled human–natural system to support multidisciplinary approaches and avoid potential policy spillover effects. We discuss current scale-dependent challenges in tackling drought-induced food security whilst minimizing water use conflicts and environmental impacts.
abstract_zh: 理解干旱与粮食安全之间跨尺度的联系，对于开发降低干旱影响的工具并支持决策制定至关重要。本研究回顾了干旱灾害如何通过物理过程和社会-环境系统的变化，在广泛的空间和时间尺度上传导为粮食不安全。我们提出了一个多尺度综合框架，该框架利用建模进展（如干旱和作物监测、水-粮食-能源关联、决策制定）以及数据可获得性的提高（如卫星遥感、粮食贸易），并以耦合的人-自然系统为视角，以支持多学科方法，并避免潜在的政策溢出效应。我们讨论了在应对干旱引发的粮食安全问题时，当前面临的尺度依赖性挑战，同时尽量减少用水冲突和环境影响。

Evidence for the Impacts of Agroforestry on Agricultural Productivity, Ecosystem Services, and Human Well-Being in High-Income Countries: A Systematic Map Protocol.
abstract:
Agroforestry bridges the gap that often separates agriculture and forestry by building integrated systems that address both environmental and socio-economic objectives. Agroforestry can improve the resiliency of agricultural systems and mitigate the impacts of climate change. Existing research suggests that integrating trees on farms can prevent environmental degradation, improve agricultural productivity, increase carbon sequestration, generate cleaner water, and support healthy soil and healthy ecosystems while providing stable incomes and other benefits to human welfare. Although these claims are becoming more widely accepted as the body of agroforestry research increases, systematic understanding of the evidence supporting them remains lacking for high-income countries. This systematic map will address this research need by providing a tool for identifying and visualizing the existing evidence demonstrating the impacts of agroforestry practices and interventions on agricultural productivity, ecosystem services, and human well-being. The results will be useful for informing policy decisions and future research by making the evidence easily accessible and highlighting the gaps in knowledge as well as areas with enough evidence to conduct systematic reviews.
This systematic map will identify, collect, display, and describe available evidence on the impacts of agroforestry on agricultural productivity, ecosystem services, and human well-being in high-income countries. The search strategy will cover 5 primary databases and 24 organizational websites using a pre-defined search string designed to capture studies relating agroforestry practices and interventions to outcomes in high-income countries. The searches will all be conducted in English. We will screen the identified studies for inclusion or exclusion in stages, first on title and abstract and then on full-text. We will collect data from studies included at the full-text stage to form the map and associated database. For inclusion, the study in question must assess the impacts of the deliberate promotion and/or actual integration of woody perennials (trees, shrubs, palms, bamboos, etc.) on the same land management unit as agricultural crops and/or animals.
abstract_zh:
农林复合经营弥合了农业与林业之间常见的鸿沟，通过构建综合系统来同时实现环境和社会经济目标。农林复合经营可以提高农业系统的韧性，并减缓气候变化的影响。现有研究表明，在农场中整合树木可以防止环境退化、提高农业生产力、增加碳汇、生成更清洁的水，并支持健康的土壤和生态系统，同时提供稳定的收入以及其他有利于人类福祉的益处。尽管随着农林复合经营研究文献的增多，这些论断正被越来越广泛地接受，但对于高收入国家而言，支持这些论断的证据体系仍缺乏系统性的认识。本系统性证据图谱旨在满足这一研究需求，为识别和可视化现有证据提供工具，这些证据表明农林复合经营实践和干预措施对农业生产力、生态系统服务和人类福祉的影响。研究结果将有助于为政策决策和未来研究提供参考，使证据易于获取，并突出知识空白，以及证据充足、足以开展系统综述的领域。
本系统性证据图谱将识别、收集、展示并描述高收入国家中农林复合经营对农业生产力、生态系统服务和人类福祉影响的现有证据。检索策略将覆盖5个主要数据库和24个机构网站，使用预先设定的检索式，旨在涵盖将农林复合经营实践和干预措施与高收入国家的结果相关联的研究。所有检索均以英文进行。我们将分阶段筛选所识别的研究是否纳入或排除，首先依据标题和摘要，然后依据全文。我们将从进入全文阶段的纳入研究中收集数据，以形成证据图谱及相关数据库。纳入标准要求，所考察的研究必须评估在同一土地经营单元上有意推广和/或实际整合木本多年生植物（乔木、灌木、棕榈、竹类等）与农作物和/或牲畜的影响。

Towards a Theoretical Construct for Modelling Smallholders' Forestland-Use Decisions: What can we Learn from Agriculture and Forest Economics?
abstract: Academic research on smallholders’ forestland-use decisions is regularly addressed in different streams of literature using different theoretical constructs that are independently incomplete. In this article, we propose a theoretical construct for modelling smallholders’ forestland-use decisions intended to serve in the guidance and operationalization of future models for quantitative analysis. Our construct is inspired by the sub-disciplines of forestry and agricultural economics with a crosscutting theme of how transaction costs drive separability between consumption and production decisions. Our results help explain why exogenous variables proposed in the existing literature are insufficient at explaining smallholders’ forestland-use decisions, and provide theoretical context for endogenizing characteristics of the household, farm and landscape. Smallholders’ forestland-use decisions are best understood in an agricultural context of competing uses for household assets and interdependent consumption and production decisions. Forest production strategies range from natural regeneration to intensive management of the forest resource to co-jointly produce market and non-market values. Due to transaction costs, decision prices are best represented by their shadow as opposed to market prices. Shadow prices are shaped by endogenous smallholder-specific preferences for leisure, non-market values, time, risk, and uncertainty. Our proposed construct is intended to provide a theoretical basis to assist modellers in the selection of variables for quantitative analysis.
abstract_zh: 关于小农林地利用决策的学术研究，常见于不同的文献脉络，并采用各自独立而不完整的理论构念。本文提出一个用于为小农林地利用决策建模的理论构念，旨在指导和支撑未来定量分析模型的构建与操作化。我们的构念受林学和农业经济学两个分支学科的启发，其贯穿的主题是交易成本如何驱动消费决策与生产决策之间的可分性。我们的结果有助于解释，为何现有文献中提出的外生变量不足以解释小农的林地利用决策，并为内生化家庭、农场和景观特征提供理论依据。小农的林地利用决策，在家庭资产存在多种竞争性用途、消费与生产决策相互依存的农业背景下，才能得到最好的理解。森林生产策略从自然更新到对森林资源的集约化经营，涵盖范围广泛，旨在共同生产市场价值与非市场价值。由于交易成本的存在，决策价格最好以影子价格而非市场价格来表示。影子价格受小农内生的个人偏好影响，这些偏好包括对闲暇、非市场价值、时间、风险和不确定性的偏好。我们提出的构念旨在为建模者在选择定量分析变量时提供理论基础。

title: Can Peers Improve Agricultural Revenue?
Emerging evidence on the effectiveness of tropical forest conservation
abstract: The PLOS ONE Collection "Measuring forest conservation effectiveness" brings together a series of studies that evaluate the effectiveness of tropical forest conservation policies and programs with the goal of measuring conservation success and associated co-benefits. This overview piece describes the geographic and methodological scope of these studies, as well as the policy instruments covered in the Collection as of June 2016. Focusing on forest cover change, we systematically compare the conservation effects estimated by the studies and discuss them in the light of previous findings in the literature. Nine studies estimated that annual conservation impacts on forest cover were below one percent, with two exceptions in Mexico and Indonesia. Differences in effect sizes are not only driven by the choice of conservation measures. One key lesson from the studies is the need to move beyond the current scientific focus of estimating average effects of undifferentiated conservation programs. The specific elements of the program design and the implementation context are equally important factors for understanding the effectiveness of conservation programs. Particularly critical will be a better understanding of the causal mechanisms through which conservation programs have impacts. To achieve this understanding we need advances in both theory and methods.
abstract_zh: 《PLOS ONE》期刊的“衡量森林保护成效”专辑汇集了一系列研究，这些研究评估热带森林保护政策和项目的有效性，旨在衡量保护成功与相关协同效益。本综述文章描述了这些研究的地理和方法范围，以及截至2016年6月专辑所涵盖的政策工具。聚焦于森林覆盖变化，我们系统比较了各项研究估计的保护效果，并结合文献中已有的发现加以讨论。九项研究估计，每年对森林覆盖的保护效果低于1%，仅墨西哥和印度尼西亚两个例外。效应大小的差异不仅由保护措施的选择所驱动。这些研究的一个重要启示是，需要超越当前仅估计无差别保护项目平均效果的科学关注点。项目设计的具体要素和实施环境同样是理解保护项目有效性的重要因素。尤为关键的是，需要更好地理解保护项目产生影响的因果机制。要实现这一认识，我们需要在理论和方法上同时取得进展。

abstract: We extend the model of Fullerton, Karney, and Baylis (2012 working paper) to explore cost-effectiveness of unilateral climate policy in the presence of leakage. We ignore the welfare gain from reducing greenhouse gas emissions and focus on the welfare cost of the emissions tax or permit scheme. Whereas that prior paper solves for changes in emissions quantities and finds that leakage may be negative, we show here that all cases with negative leakage in that model are cases where a unilateral carbon tax results in a welfare loss. With positive leakage, however, a unilateral policy can improve welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们扩展了Fullerton、Karney和Baylis（2012年工作论文）的模型，以探讨在存在碳泄漏的情况下，单边气候政策的成本有效性。我们暂不考虑减少温室气体排放所带来的福利收益，而是聚焦于排放税或许可交易制度的福利成本。在该先前论文中，模型求解了排放量的变化，并发现碳泄漏可能为负；而我们在此表明，在该模型中所有出现负泄漏的情形，都是单边碳税导致福利损失的情形。然而，在存在正泄漏的情况下，单边政策可以改善福利。

venue: Journal of Agriculture and Applied Economics
abstract: Panel data are used in almost all subfields of the agricultural economics profession. Furthermore, many research areas have an important spatial dimension. This article discusses some of the recent contributions made in the evolving theoretical and empirical literature on spatial econometric methods for panel data. We then illustrate some of these tools within a climate change application using a hedonic model of farmland values and panel data. Estimates for the model are provided across a range of nonspatial and spatial estimators, including spatial error and spatial lag models with fixed and random effects extensions. Given the importance of location and extensive use of panel data in many subfields of agricultural economics, these recently developed spatial panel methods hold great potential for applied researchers.
abstract_zh: 面板数据几乎被用于农业经济学领域的所有分支学科。此外，许多研究领域都具有重要的空间维度。本文讨论了关于面板数据空间计量经济学方法的理论和实证文献的一些最新进展。随后，我们利用基于农田价值特征价格模型（hedonic model）及面板数据的气候变化应用，阐释了其中的一些工具。我们提供了一系列非空间与空间估计量的模型估计结果，包括带固定效应和随机效应扩展的空间误差模型和空间滞后模型。鉴于地理位置的重要性以及面板数据在农业经济学众多分支中的广泛使用，这些新近发展的空间面板方法对应用研究人员具有巨大潜力。

venue: International Journal of Agriculture, Resources and Governance and Ecology
abstract: The challenge for any trade agreement is to be adaptable enough to enable countries to address legitimate non-trade concerns (NTC) while being restrictive enough to limit harm to other countries and to assist the creation of free international markets. In this paper, we focus on how environmental NTC have been addressed in agricultural policy in the USA and the European Union (EU) and the resulting implications for trade agreements. For example, programmes in the USA discourage production on environmentally sensitive land, while the EU encourages extensive production. While these and other differences will affect production and trade, the different approaches to agri-environmental policy affect the degree to which the two regions can use agri-environmental policy to offset commodity payments. This difference in flexibility will, in turn, affect how easily the two regions can accept a trade agreement that mandates greater reductions in trade-distorting price supports.
abstract_zh: 任何贸易协定面临的挑战，在于既要具备足够的灵活性，使各国能够应对合理的非贸易关切（NTC），又要具备足够的约束力，以限制对其他国家的损害并促进自由的国际市场形成。本文关注美国和欧盟（EU）的农业政策如何应对环境类非贸易关切，以及由此对贸易协定产生的影响。例如，美国的计划鼓励减少在环境敏感土地上的生产，而欧盟则鼓励粗放型生产。尽管这些差异及其他差异将影响生产和贸易，但两地不同的农业环境政策方式，决定了两地在多大程度上能够利用农业环境政策来抵消商品补贴。这种灵活性的差异，反过来将影响两地接受一项要求大幅削减贸易扭曲性价格支持的贸易协定的难易程度。

abstract: Conservation programs are a significant part of farm legislation. The recent farm bill increases funding of conservation programs. One result will likely be the increased adoption of basic environmentally benign farming practices, such as conservation tillage. This would lead to improvements in surface water quality. In this paper, we examine the magnitude of the nonmarket use value benefits of these improvements. The findings indicate that moderate to widespread adoption of practices such as conservation tillage would result in significant nonmarket benefits.
abstract_zh: 保护性项目是农业立法的重要组成部分。近期的农业法案增加了对保护性项目的资金投入。其结果很可能是保护性耕作等基本的环境友好型农业做法被更多采用，从而改善地表水质量。本文考察了这些改善所带来的非市场使用价值效益的大小。研究结果表明，保护性耕作等做法的中等至广泛采用，将带来显著的非市场效益。
